note: Media Document is a glue submodule of Lightning Media: hook_media_source_info_alter() sets $sources['file']['input_match']['field_types'] = ['file'] and calls Override::pluginClass($sources['file'], File::class), where File extends core's file source and mixes in FileInputExtensionMatchTrait. No routes, permissions, services, settings form (configure = null), config schema, Drush commands or plugin types. config/optional ships media.type.document (source file, source field field_media_document, default extensions 'txt rtf doc docx ppt pptx xls xlsx pdf odf odg odp ods odt fodt fods fodp fodg key numbers pages'), field_media_in_library, and default/media_library/embedded/thumbnail displays.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal module lightning_media_document add to a site, and which media source plugin and source field does its media type use?
evals.expected_output: It installs a Document media type (media.type.document) using core's 'file' media source with the source field field_media_document, whose default allowed extensions cover txt rtf doc docx ppt pptx xls xlsx pdf odf odg odp ods odt fodt fods fodp fodg key numbers pages, plus field_media_in_library and default/media_library/embedded/thumbnail displays.

evals.prompt: Besides swapping the media source class, lightning_media_document sets one extra key on the core 'file' media source plugin definition in hook_media_source_info_alter(). Which key, and what is it for?
evals.expected_output: It sets $sources['file']['input_match']['field_types'] = ['file'], declaring which field types Lightning Media's input matching may consider for this source, alongside Override::pluginClass($sources['file'], File::class) which mixes in InputMatchInterface via FileInputExtensionMatchTrait.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site running several Lightning Media components, uploading a file through an entity browser sometimes fails with an IndeterminateBundleException. Given how broad the Document media type's extension list is, why does that happen and how do I fix it?
evals.expected_output: MediaHelper::getBundleFromInput() throws IndeterminateBundleException when zero or more than one media type's InputMatchInterface::appliesTo() claims the input. Because Document accepts a very broad extension list it can collide with another component; fix it by narrowing settings.file_extensions on field.field.media.document.field_media_document (or on the competing type's source field).

evals.prompt: Inspect the live configuration of this Drupal site and tell me exactly which file extensions the Document media type currently accepts for upload, and on which field that setting is stored.
evals.expected_output: field.field.media.document.field_media_document has settings.file_extensions set to 'pdf docx csv', so only PDF, DOCX and CSV uploads are accepted.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, an editor complains that a large PDF is rejected by the Document media type. Inspect the live field configuration and tell me the maximum upload size currently configured for that media type's source field.
evals.expected_output: field.field.media.document.field_media_document has settings.max_filesize set to '7 MB', so uploads above 7 MB are rejected regardless of the PHP limit.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Document media type accepts a very long list of file extensions. Lock it down so that editors can only upload PDF and DOCX files - nothing else. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: field.field.media.document.field_media_document settings.file_extensions is exactly 'pdf docx' (in any order), with every other extension removed.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a Document media item named 'LM Document Task' whose source field references a real file entity, and make sure it is visible in the media library.
evals.expected_output: A media entity of bundle 'document' named 'LM Document Task' whose field_media_document references a saved File entity and whose field_media_in_library is TRUE.
